title: YouTube Metadata with FlashData
description: Enter your Key and required video_id input. Start performs one YouTube Metadata request using your FlashData Credits.

flashdataApiKey.title: FlashData API key
flashdataApiKey.description: Your own FlashData API key with YouTube Metadata permission. Encrypted; no shared key is provided.

video_id.title: Video Id
video_id.description: An 11-character YouTube video ID, not a full URL.

include_formats.title: Include Formats
include_formats.description: Include available video/audio format metadata, without downloading files.
